ui.title: Product Video Studio
ui.tagline: A video producer agent that turns a short brief, and optionally a product photo, into a finished narrated video: it writes the script, voices every scene with the platform's text-to-speech, builds 3D scenes with Remotion and three.js, renders an MP4 in the sandbox and shows it in the chat.

actions.label: Run: Script, approve, produce
actions.description: Run by the product video studio. Kaman writes a scene-by-scene script for the brief, checks its length and claims in code, tightens it if it runs long, has marketing approve the script, and only then has the Video Producer voice, render and deliver the video.

inputs.name: brief
inputs.label: Brief
inputs.default: Halo, a smart water bottle that glows when it is time to drink, tracks every sip and keeps water cold for 24 hours.

actions.label: Ask the Video Producer
actions.description: Makes narrated product videos from a brief and a product photo.
